def solve_small_2(k, n, target):
    S = [1] * n
    W = [j for j in range(n)]
    for _ in range(k):
        new_S = []
        new_W = []
        for i in range(len(S) - 1):
            new_S.append(S[i])
            new_W.append(W[i])
            new_S.append(S[i] + S[i+1])
            new_W.append(W[i] + W[i+1])
        new_S.append(S[-1])
        new_W.append(W[-1])
        S = new_S
        W = new_W
    
    count = 0
    for i in range(len(S)):
        if W[i] + S[i] == target:
            count += 1
    return count
